nodes.label: D-57 New agent notebooks visible to all connected agents
nodes.rationale: allNotebooks flag on grant so a new 'for agents' notebook appears without reconnecting; migration 0009, enforced in RLS; agents can trash but never permanently delete notes

nodes.label: D-56 ds:// custom URL scheme for app links
nodes.rationale: Own ds:// scheme carrying server address instead of Universal Links; removes applinks, Associated Domains and DS_WEB_HOST so the build contains no domain

nodes.label: D-55 Admin backup and migration over SSH
nodes.rationale: Keep backup/restore simple: admin CLI commands, no external storage or UI buttons; DS_KMS_KEY shown once only in terminal

nodes.label: D-54 Account-based sharing
nodes.rationale: Simple variant: share notebook or note by email with editor/read-only roles, in-app invites, 'Shared with me', version history with authors; no groups, admins or audit log. Accounts created after invite get access only after owner confirmation; guest links recreated after key rotation

nodes.label: D-54 amendment: participant's own AI in shared notebooks
nodes.rationale: If owner opened a shared notebook to AI agents, a participant's agent gets the participant's role (editor writes, reader reads) without a new toggle

nodes.label: D-53 Revoked device wipes its data
nodes.rationale: Disconnected device erases local data with warnings beforehand; signup stays open; 10 GB per account; main branch protected; demo crash downgraded to warning

nodes.label: D-52 Server fetches remote images for web paste
nodes.rationale: Web CSP is not weakened; server downloads with SSRF protection, images only, no SVG, <=20 MB, 15 s, addresses not logged

nodes.label: D-51 Minimal notes-only mode (KISS)
nodes.rationale: Default to notes with formatting, pen, AI access and sharing; tasks, calendar, tabs, collections hidden behind extended-mode build flag while code stays alive and tested

nodes.label: D-50 GNU AGPL-3.0-only license
nodes.rationale: Whole project AGPL-3.0-only with CLA in CONTRIBUTING.md; rights held by owner

nodes.label: D-49 Server address entered at login
nodes.rationale: Server address not baked into build; sharing links carry the server; amended so our server is never shown (empty required field); deploy logs mask the domain

nodes.label: D-48 Fully isolated spaces
nodes.rationale: Favorites, tabs, tasks, calendar, daily notes, tags, search, trash and link suggestions are scoped to current space; cross-space link switches space; moving only via explicit command

nodes.label: D-47 iPad at most two adjacent column levels
nodes.rationale: Sidebar|list or list|document; fullscreen and close only on document (user feedback on build 10)

nodes.label: D-46 Faster iOS CI checks
nodes.rationale: gate step skips re-checking verified files on main; TestFlight build starts after smoke UI tests

nodes.label: D-45 'Created by agent' banner
nodes.rationale: A note fully created by an agent is not highlighted line by line; instead NoteMeta.createdByAgent drives a dismissible banner; D-10 highlighting stays for edits

nodes.label: D-44 iPad sidebar toggled only by its button
D-43 Device library migrates into account on login
nodes.rationale: Everything created on device before login moves into the account; notebooks registered before sync start (sync hung, POST /v1/docs 404)

nodes.label: D-42 Own UniFFI wrapper over yrs 0.25
nodes.rationale: Closes risk R-06

nodes.label: Quiet Paper design system (D-15, D-38)
nodes.rationale: Craft-inspired design; Source Serif 4 replaced Newsreader for Cyrillic support

nodes.label: D-29 Graphify workflow
nodes.rationale: Graph stored in repo; git hook reacts only to code, docs updated via tools/graphify_docs.py

nodes.label: D-21 tech stack / D-22 no custom Rust core
D-25 Redis removed (pg-boss on PostgreSQL)
nodes.rationale: Server runs as a single process; job queue on PostgreSQL

nodes.label: D-26 MinIO removed (files on disk, optional S3)
D-35 Annotation disappears with deleted text
Notebook key rotation (rotate / rotate/done, pendingSinceVersion)
nodes.rationale: Only active participants get the new key; continuation after failure from any owner device

nodes.label: KDF_BOUNDS safe KDF parameters
nodes.rationale: Reject unsafe server-sent Argon2id params (ops 3-10, mem 64-256 MiB)

nodes.label: 'One title' document contract
nodes.rationale: Clients never write a template into empty docs and repair damaged title on open, same rule for web and iOS

nodes.label: Free drawing anchor (anchorKind block, strokes §4)
nodes.rationale: Strokes far from text were dropped on iOS; now kept as free drawing near nearest paragraph

nodes.label: Pause document while key unavailable
nodes.rationale: Missing key is not corruption: pause without skipping, resume from last seq

nodes.label: Canonical server notebook key (reconcileNotebookKeys)
nodes.rationale: Prod incident: two keys for one notebook

nodes.label: Recovery key rotation and security events log
Refresh token 60 s replay window
nodes.rationale: Lost response in flaky network no longer revokes device

nodes.label: Stored document mode (live Y.Doc only for open notes)
nodes.rationale: 10 000 notes memory ~490 MB -> ~49 MB

nodes.label: Handwriting rendering to PNG for agents
